# DIO/ODI Reference Model

> Canonical machine-readable reference layer for Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI), maintained by Daniel Beránek.

## Site entry point

- Top-level Reference Model overview: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/
- Canonical Reference Vocabulary landing page: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/dio-odi/
- Application Mappings index: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/
- Corpus Metadata Registry frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/
- Semantic Change Feed frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/
- Semantic Change Feed events JSON: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/events.json
- Semantic Change Feed JSON Schema: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/schema.json
- Corpus Metadata Registry technical guide: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/README.md
- Research Genealogy frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/research-genealogy/

## Referenced research works

- The Crisis of Entity Resolution in Heterogeneous AI Environments: Data, Financial, and Semantic Dimensions — current version 1.1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22416026
  - Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22416026
  - Version 1.1.0 adds four standalone conceptual visualizations: Identity Collapse, Semantic Fragmentation, Temporal Discontinuity, and Semantic Vulnerability.
  - The primary PDF remains unchanged; the four visualizations are supplementary explanatory models.
  - The work is registered in `metadata/works.json`, cited in `metadata/references.json`, and linked from the Reference Model in `metadata/relations.json`.

## Derived application mappings

Derived mappings are not part of the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary. They apply vocabulary concepts to external technical or analytical domains without modifying canonical definitions or relations.

- Application Mappings index: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/
- Application Mapping: DIO Reconstruction Failure Modes × RAG Pipeline: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/rag-pipeline/

  - JSON-LD introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.1

  - Base mapping introduced and first archived in: Reference Model v0.2.0

  - Development context: Constraining the Commit Boundary, published 2026-10-22: https://zenodo.org/records/23580733
- Application Mapping: HEM Heterogeneity Taxonomy × DIO Reconstruction Consequences: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio/
  - Source Markdown: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/hem-dio-mapping.md

  - Introduced in: Reference Model v0.3.0

- Application Mapping: DIO/ODI Commit-Boundary Contract × Policy-as-Code Authorization: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/commit-boundary-policy/
  - Source Markdown: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/commit-boundary-policy-mapping.md
  - JSON-LD: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/commit-boundary-policy-mapping.jsonld
  - Turtle RDF: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/commit-boundary-policy-mapping.ttl
  - External technical references: OPA and Cedar
  - External cross-domain proposal: Jeremy Pickett, The Missing Ring-0 Protections for AI Agents (2026-10-30): https://hwtn.io/essays/t0013-missing-ring-0-protections-ai
  - The proposal discusses staged effects, executor-held credentials, and deterministic OPA/Cedar policy decisions for coding agents. It states that no implementation has been built and its proposed study has not been run; it is not a validated extension or implementation of the Agentic ER mapping.
  - Added to live source tree: 2026-10-25
  - Archival status: first included in archived Reference Model v0.4.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23632619; carried forward in archived v0.5.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23643845, v0.6.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23966487, and carried forward in archived v0.7.0 and v0.8.0, and included in current archived v0.9.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24085589


- Application Mapping: DIO/ODI-Informed Agentic ER Commit-Boundary Architecture (live version 0.3.1): https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/agentic-er-architecture/
  - Source Markdown: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/agentic-er-commit-boundary-architecture-mapping.md
  - JSON-LD: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/agentic-er-commit-boundary-architecture-mapping.jsonld
  - Turtle RDF: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/agentic-er-commit-boundary-architecture-mapping.ttl
  - Architecture SVG: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/agentic-er-architecture/architecture.svg
  - Live version 0.3.1 is a provenance-only synchronization to public arXiv:2610.37407v2 (2026-11-05); its 120 local architecture concepts and 206 qualified relation assertions are unchanged
  - Version 0.3.0 remains the mapping version archived in Reference Model v0.6.0
  - Version 0.3.1 was first included in archived Reference Model v0.7.0 and is carried forward in v0.8.0 and current v0.9.0 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24085589
  - Section-level source: production manuscript v55 (2026-11-04), retained as the provenance source for section anchors in public arXiv v2

## Agent-facing MCP distribution

- DIO/ODI MCP v0.1.1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24123229
- MCP Concept DOI (all versions): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24123228
- Public Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://mcp.danielberanek.cz/mcp
- Health endpoint: https://mcp.danielberanek.cz/healthz
- Source repository: https://github.com/dan-beranek/dio-odi-mcp
- Scope: Public, stateless, read-only MCP distribution exposing a bounded snapshot of the DIO/ODI Reference Model and selected derived Agentic ER and Policy-as-Code mappings. It is not an MVDIO Supervisor or authorization service and does not execute application-side authorization or mutate application state.

## Related Agentic ER planning product

Agentic Entity Resolution Guardrail Planner is a separate published design-time Agent Skill. It prepares reviewable engineering plans for identity-changing operations; it does not execute mutations, authorize production writes, or deploy a runtime guard.
- Agensi listing: https://www.agensi.io/r/DANIELBERANEK?to=/skills/agentic-entity-resolution-guardrail-planner
- Product source repository: https://github.com/dan-beranek/agentic-entity-resolution-guardrail-planner

## Semantic Change Feed

- Human-readable frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/
- Canonical append-only event feed: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/events.json
- JSON Schema: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/schema.json
- Technical specification: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/semantic-change-feed/README.md
- Purpose: source-backed history of semantic, structural, provenance, mapping, and artifact-state changes; not a Git commit log
- Boundary: does not replace the Reference Vocabulary, Application Mappings, Corpus Metadata Registry, or immutable Reference Model releases
- Feed version: 0.1.12; current live append-only structured history, first published as v0.1.0, with explicit date basis, preserved invariants, impact, provenance, and lineage
- Live JSON Schema version: 0.2.1
- Archived snapshot in Reference Model v0.9.0: feed v0.1.1, schema v0.2.0, 45 events through 9 November 2026
- Live-feed status: operational maintenance after the v0.9.0 archive; these updates do not create a new Reference Model release or alter any archived package

- Current coverage: full dated Hub Changelog (25 March–25 October 2026) plus subsequent publication, research-portfolio, archive-reconciliation, MCP deployment/validation, MCP Zenodo DOI-publication, BioRegistry and Semantic Farm `dio-odi` prefix/resolver integrations, BARTOC KOS cataloguing, Agentic ER planning product publication and product-website deployment, ARD / Common AI Catalog agent-discovery deployment, the MCP service-level RFC 9727 API Catalog deployment, and two author-led Ecommerce Bridge expert contributions on multi-epistemic copywriting and cross-representation e-commerce identity consistency, plus the FAIRsharing record #9470 for the Reference Vocabulary through 24 November 2026

## Research Genealogy

- The professional ethnography is the primary multimodal research object from which DIO was derived: https://danielberanek.cz/od-pultu-az-k-seo-a-copy-s-ostrymi-hroty-profesni-bio/
- The author-maintained changelog records DIO articulation on 21 May 2026 and ODI articulation on 22 June 2026.
- The Research Genealogy Registry records the exploratory process, dated milestones, selected model-generated readings, and SlideShare archive attribution.
- SlideShare profile and exploratory/publication artefact archive: https://www.slideshare.net/danielberanek
- The registry distinguishes AI-assisted readings of the professional ethnography from model-generated conceptual notes and presentation layers for existing research works.

## DIO to DIO research portfolio

- Public portfolio: https://dan-beranek.github.io/dio-to-dio/
- Repository: https://github.com/dan-beranek/dio-to-dio
- Eleven author-led, model-specific analyses of DIO/ODI reconstruction, with different observation snapshots and graph approaches; the reports are not harmonized, ranked, or synthesized.
- The portfolio is a discovery and interpretive corpus, not an authoritative chronology. Verify historical claims against primary publications, release records, registries, and archives.

  - Grammar version: 2.0.0
  - Status: canonical-approved
  - Work-specific profile: commit-boundary-paper (31 terms; baseline aligned to Zenodo v1 metadata)
  - Work-specific profile: mcp-server (51 terms; approved in registry v2.11.0)
  - Order: C0 Identity → C1 Environments → C2 Work positioning → C3 Mechanics → C4 Semantic Connectome → C5 Failures/robustness → C6 Machine-readable representation
- Zenodo projection for future GitHub releases: repository root `/.zenodo.json`

This registry is an operational metadata layer and does not modify the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary.

## External Reception
- Frontend: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/external-reception/
- Registry JSON: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/external-reception.json
- JSON Schema: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/external-reception.schema.json
- RDF/Turtle: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/metadata/external-reception.ttl
- Scope: external technical analyses, conceptual uptake, agent-account discussions, AI summaries, research-discovery profiles, editorial summaries, and external registry, KOS-catalogue, and interoperability integrations linked to specific research works or canonical reference artifacts
- Boundary: operational reception/provenance layer; not the canonical Reference Vocabulary, internal inter-work bibliography, or Semantic Change Feed
- Citation rule: CiTO citation relations are emitted only for explicit source references; topical similarity and indexing do not imply citation
- Authorship rule: agent-account attribution or a platform verification badge does not establish autonomous authorship
- Implementation rule: proposals, illustrative validators, summaries, and indexes are not represented as production implementations
- Commit Boundary mapping: https://vocab.danielberanek.cz/mappings/commit-boundary-policy/
- Wren-Castillo reception belongs to The Crisis of Entity Resolution: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22416026
